step-1.text: Lay the desk top upside down on the flattened box or a rug, so the good side stays scratch-free.

step-2.text: Slide the side brackets onto the ends of the crossbeam, set it in the middle of the top, and stretch it out until the brackets sit near the ends. Screw both brackets into the top.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 crossbeam, 2 side brackets and 8 screws.

step-3.text: Set each lifting column onto its bracket, motor end against the beam, and bolt it down. Cables face the back.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 lifting columns and 8 bolts.

step-4.text: Bolt a foot across the end of each column, longer side toward the front. Check both feet point the same way.

count-4.text: This step uses 2 foots and 8 bolts.

step-5.text: Screw the control box under the top near the back, and the keypad under the front edge on the side you prefer.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 control box, 1 keypad and 6 screws.

step-6.text: Plug both motor cables and the keypad cable into the control box, then tuck everything into the cable tray and screw the tray on. Do not plug into the wall yet.

count-6.text: This step uses 1 cable tray and 4 screws.

step-7.text: With a helper, lift the desk and turn it onto its feet. Lift it clear, do not pivot it on one leg.

count-7.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-8.text: Plug it in, then run the first-time reset from your manual, usually holding the down button until the desk bottoms out. Test up and down with nothing on top.

count-8.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your ARK SD standing desk 55" with drawer is built. Give it a proud little pat.
